Last week, we discussed the traveling salesman problem (TSP), which (as in lawn mowing) seeks the shortest tour to cover some object.
The distinction is that TSP runs on a combinatorial object, while lawn mowing is a geometric problem on the plane.
My goal today is to illustrate the thought process behind generalization, through an instructive case study in [@arkin2000approximation].
While the specific results are not the main point, they will also be used in future weeks.
